import os
import sys
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

# Determine label configuration from sample submission
n_labels = (
    len(sample_sub.columns) - 1
)  # Fixed: Changed from -2 to -1 to correctly count 6 labels + 1 id
label_cols = [col for col in sample_sub.columns if col not in ["id"]]
print(f"Number of labels: {n_labels}")
print(f"Label columns: {label_cols}")

# Feature extraction pipeline
pipe = Pipeline(
    [
        (
            "vectorizer",
            CountVectorizer(
                lowercase=True,
                ngram_range=(1, 2),
                max_features=50000,
                min_df=1,
                stop_words="english",
                encoding="utf-8",
                analyzer="char_wb",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "classifier",
            OneVsRestClassifier(
                LogisticRegression(
                    solver="lbfgs",
                    multi_class="auto",
                    max_iter=1000,
                    C=0.5,
                    penalty="l2",
                    class_weight="balanced",
                    random_state=42,
                )
            ),
        ),
    ]
)

# Prepare features
X_train_full = train_df["comment_text"]
y_train = train_df[label_cols].astype(float).values
X_test = test_df["comment_text"]

# Split for validation (stratified by presence of labels)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full,
    y_train,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train.sum(axis=1) > 0,
)

print(f"Training set: {len(X_tr)}, Validation set: {len(X_val)}")

# Fit on training set only
pipe.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validate against column-wise ROC AUC metric
print("\nValidation Performance (Column-wise ROC AUC):")
auc_scores = []
for i in range(n_labels):
    val_true = y_val[:, i]
    y_val_pred_col = pipe.predict_proba(X_val)[:, i]

    # Handle edge cases
    if np.all(val_true == 0) or np.all(val_true == 1):
        auc = 0.5
    else:
        try:
            auc = roc_auc_score(val_true, y_val_pred_col)
        except ValueError:
            auc = 0.5
    auc_scores.append(auc)
    print(f"{label_cols[i]:15s}: ROC_AUC = {auc:.4f}")

mean_auc = sum(auc_scores) / len(auc_scores)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for full test set
test_predictions = pipe.predict_proba(X_test)

# Create submission file ensuring exact match with sample header structure
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        **{label_cols[i]: test_predictions[:, i] for i in range(n_labels)},
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
print(f"Total rows submitted: {len(submission_df)}")
